opening->A Colonization Fleet field manual on [spell_label], compiled by the Mage Tower from what survived of Anima Prime's bloodline teachings.
opening->This manual breaks [spell_label] down into numbered drills, the way the Fleet teaches everything else.
opening->Standard issue for Militärmagier training: [spell_label], one drill to a page.
detail->It reads less like a grimoire than a rifle manual, which is the point.
detail->Diagrams of hand and breath placement fill every other page.
detail->The margins are crowded with a previous owner's notes, most of them corrections.
detail(quality[less_than]3)->Several pages have been reprinted crooked, and one drill is missing a step.
detail(quality[greater_than]3)->This edition includes the annotated drills used at the Mage Tower itself.
stamp->A stamp inside the cover reads: "Property of the Fleet. Not to be lent."
stamp->The inside cover lists six previous holders. Five of the names have been struck through.
stamp->A requisition slip is still tucked inside the back cover.
